ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels. High-intensity pixels are localized primarily on the distal edges and tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches occupy the outer third of both lobes. Significant black mottling and stippling are present within the white areas, particularly along the inner boundary transitions. The central core and notch area are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated angle approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the fluke blades.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serration across the entire span. Left lobe displays 4-5 prominent peaks. Right lobe features a significant irregular concave indentation (notch) approximately 75% distal from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the lower edges curving upward toward the distal tips; left lobe exhibits a more vertical terminal sweep than the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct high-contrast circular ring-shaped scars (white outlines on black background) located in the mid-left quadrant of the central dark region. Clusters of white calcified growths (barnacles) are visible on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear marks are visible traversing the black pigmentation on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular indentation on the right trailing edge suggesting prior tissue loss; multiple circular depigmented lesions on the left central fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique pair of concentric circular scars in the central-left black field.
